ledger.note: 1204: Boniface grants the pass of Thermopylae to Guy Pallavicini. The marquisate was 'originally granted as a margravial holding of Guy Pallavicini by Boniface', 'first king of Thessalonica'; 'Its original purpose was to guard the pass of Thermopylae.'

1335: the Venetian Zorzi succeed. 'Venetian families then took over, with the Cornaro holding it until 1335 and the Zorzi following'; Guglielma Pallavicini (1311-1358) had Zorzi and Zaccaria husbands, and Nicholas I Zorzi is listed from 1335. The Catalan Company, which arrived in 1311, did not end the marquisate.

ledger.note: 1414: the Ottomans take Bodonitsa. 'The Ottomans took the territory'; the Zorzi lost it and Nicholas II kept the title though the land was never regained.
